text: Choosing storage — OLTP versus OLAP versus object storage. Three shapes you already know, recognized here as a real choice.
OLTP is fast for single-row reads and writes. OLAP is fast for aggregating across millions of rows. Object storage is cheap and durable, with no fast query pattern built in yet.
The vendor's booking app needs OLTP. Raw incoming files need object storage. Aggregated dashboards need OLAP. Each piece of the platform has a different read pattern.
The medallion architecture is this exact idea, formalized — bronze, silver, gold. Next up: choosing a processing model — batch, streaming, or hybrid, the same kind of choice, one layer up.
